scope: Standard user SSH config and system SSH config plus their declared Include files only. No arbitrary filesystem/key/known_hosts scan. Host/HostName/User/Port/Include are exported; Match condition values and all proxy/credential fields are omitted.
conclusions: No hostname/IP/SSH alias inferred from Syncthing device name home.
Absence of a configured alias does not establish Home lacks SSH or any externally documented route; no usable authenticated/trusted access has been demonstrated here.
features/HANDOFF Home verification remains primary until maintainer supplies exact trusted host/identity/destination mapping.
no_actions: No SSH or remote connection, network call, command evaluation, key/credential access, config change or daemon action.
No private keys, tokens, passwords, ProxyCommand contents, arbitrary Host Match exec clauses or known_hosts entries read/exported.
limitations: Static parsing is not OpenSSH effective configuration evaluation. First-value precedence, Host patterns, negation and conditional Match/Include runtime semantics are not executed.
